context.text: Compare 2305.18323 and 2312.04511 on how they handle tool outputs

Answer: ReWOO plans every tool call before seeing any output, while LLMCompiler runs independent calls in parallel as their inputs become ready [E1, E4]
ReWOO's Solver reads the observations only after all Workers finish [E2]
LLMCompiler's Task Fetching Unit replaces placeholders with earlier outputs [E5]
Sources: arxiv:2305.18323v1, arxiv:2312.04511v3
